Accomplishment
1. Distinguished Professor of Finance, Rutgers Univ.1988-2018

2. Director of Annual Conference on Pacific Basin Finance, Economics, Accounting, and Management 1993-present

3. Special Recognition Award for his dedication and diligence as a Founding Father of The Financial Economics and Accounting Conference (Founded in 1990)

4. Ranked the Most Published Finance Professor Worldwide during 1953-2008.

5. Published Four Hanji and One English books

6. Siwei Cheng Award in Quantitative Management by International Academy of Information Technology and Quantitative Management (IAITQM) in April 2013 (成思危數量管理獎)

7. The Dean’s Lifetime Meritorious Award for the Research for the academic year of 2013-2014

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 09/2018

Hobby
